description: "The Story of Venus and Tannhäuser: A Romantic Novel" by Aubrey Beardsley is a romantic novel written in the early 20th century. It presents a fantastical narrative surrounding the legendary characters of Tannhäuser, a knight who ventures into the realm of Venus, the goddess of love.
